summary: Updates a scene node's collision and visibility state without setting a full world transform: branches on a node flag bit at this+0x3C, performs transform/bone copies through the scene-manager vtable, runs collision contact detection and AABB visibility classification, then finalizes rendering/material state (mesh dirty flags) according to node state flag bits.

operations.description: Read the node flag byte at this+0x3C (this+60); if bit 0x10 is set take the transform path, otherwise take the simple path.
Called by AnimationDispatchWithSkipFlag to update a scene node without a full world transform.

Transform path: if flag 0x20000000 is not yet set on node state a3+20, indirect-call the scene-manager vtable slot 1 behind dword_8B8F24 to copy a transform (source this+0x204 + 220, destination a3+232, matrix this+416), then set flag 0x20000000.
Transform path: run CollisionContactStateDetection on the node state with contact data at a3+232.

Transform path: if state bit 4 is set and bit 8 is not set, set bit 8 and loop 8 times indirect-calling the scene-manager vtable slot 1 to copy eight bone transforms (stride 12 bytes) against the matrix at this+416.
Transform path: classify visibility via AABBFrustumVisibilityClassification using the AABB at a3+124.
Simple path: run CollisionContactStateDetection with contact data at a3+220; if state bit 4 is set, classify visibility with the AABB at a3+28.

Read node state flags a3+20; if bit 5 (result & 5) is set, enter finalization: in the transform path, when bits 0x20 and 0x2000000 are clear, if the extra data at a3+284 has bit 0x100 set call sub_55ED10(this, a3, this+276), and if bit 0x100000 is set call sub_55D5C0(a2, 0) then return sub_556D60(a3, a2).

Simple path: if bit 0x10000000 is set, loop over the count at a3+280, setting bit 0x400 on each entry (stride 64 bytes) starting at a3+284+56 and calling sub_55D720(a2, 1) per entry; clear bit 0x10000000; then return sub_556D60(a3, a2).
Return the node state flags read from a3+20 when the bit-5 branch is not taken.
